en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, from Humran who said,

(It has been narrated) ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws or Abu Ja’farasws about a man, upon whom the Penalty (Hadd) was established in the world, would he be Punished in the Hereafter?’ So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj is more benevolent than that (to Punish twice)’.
